concept:
Create ONE complete canonical concept of GUARAVENTO, the maned-wolf living-kite creature in reference 1, for our Brazilian monster-tamer. References 2 and 3 define current handmade flat paper-art finish, NOT anatomy. Preserve Guaravento's own identity: tall slender MANED WOLF with four long black legs, orange-red faceted mane and body, ivory throat and muzzle, very large pointed black-edged ears, small dark alert eyes, long slim muzzle, a structural RED/IVORY/CHARCOAL GEOMETRIC KITE SAIL rising organically from the shoulder/back with bamboo spars and cord ties, and a long attached red/ivory/black strip-paper ribbon tail. No ordinary furry animal carrying a decorative kite; its mane and body must be folded paper planes, legs structural black paper over light spars, sail integrated into the back. Preserve the distinctive red, ivory, black angular sail patterns rather than adding gems.
VIEW NON-NEGOTIABLE: clear THREE-QUARTER standing pose FACING RIGHT, turned about 30 degrees away from pure side profile toward the viewer. Show near side AND chest, both eyes visible with far eye smaller. Four anatomically correct long legs visible or partially occluded, nearer paws slightly larger. Not frontal symmetrical and not pure side profile. Neutral poised watchful stance, all paws down, ears listening, tail sweeps left without crossing legs.
ART: same dark clean slightly stepped ink outlines and broad angular folded-paper planes as the approved Carcara and Nozinho references. Restrained 2–3 flat shadow values per material, a couple of discreet handmade paper repairs/stitches on the sail. Small matte dark eyes with alert brows, no large white sclera, no sparkling eyes. Readable paper clusters, not realistic fur strands; no glossy 3D, no gradients or cinematic lighting. Keep a dignified slender maned-wolf silhouette, not a generic chubby fox or dog, not a bird.
Transparent background, generous empty margin around ENTIRE sail tip, all four paws and complete connected ribbon tail. Single complete character, no props outside anatomy, no text, labels, borders, ground shadow or checkerboard. This pose will guide an articulated rig with torso, head/mane, four legs, sail and ribbon tail.
parts:
Create an articulated ANIMATION PARTS SHEET of GUARAVENTO from this exact reference. Preserve the tall slender maned-wolf identity, orange-red folded-paper mane/body, ivory throat/muzzle, long black legs, red/ivory/charcoal structural sail with bamboo spars and repairs, attached geometric paper ribbon tail. Everything is flat handmade kite paper, no fur texture or glossy 3D.
ALL PIECES MUST SHARE A THREE-QUARTER VIEW FACING RIGHT, near flank plus chest visible, far side foreshortened. Head shows both small dark matte eyes (far eye smaller). No bright iris/white sclera, no huge eyes. Same angle in EVERY head expression. Keep head and ear size stable.
Portrait sheet, EXACT 3 COLUMNS × 4 ROWS, with large transparent gutters and generous padding INSIDE every slot; nothing crossing slots or canvas edges. Do not draw grid or labels. Exactly ELEVEN isolated pieces, no assembled whole creature.
ROW1:
COL1: torso ONLY, horizontal rear/hip at left to chest at right, orange/black/ivory folded paper planes. No head, no neck mane/ruff, no sail, no tail, NO legs or paws. Complete shoulder and hip stubs for limb roots to overlap under body.
COL2: neutral HEAD WITH EARS AND NECK RUFF, including two large pointed black-edged ears, long ivory muzzle, black nose and orange paper mane/ivory-dark chest ruff down to neck root. NO body, NO legs. Neck attachment at bottom-left. Face turned right in three quarters, friendly watchful, tiny mouth.
COL3: complete red/ivory/charcoal BACK SAIL ONLY with bamboo frame, knots, two discreet stitched repairs, lower insertion spar at lower-right. Not wings, no attached animal parts.
ROW2:
COL1: NEAR FRONT LEG, isolated, full root at upper-left, long slender black angular leg and black paw pointing right at bottom. Short orange-paper shoulder cap only at root, no torso.
COL2: FAR FRONT LEG, same anatomy, slightly narrower/receding, full root at upper-left, black paw at bottom pointing right.
COL3: complete connected STRIP-PAPER RIBBON TAIL, root at upper-right, a generous S sweep down-left with red/ivory/charcoal geometric paper panels, tapering connected streamers at lower-left. No torso or legs, no detached bits.
ROW3:
COL1: NEAR HIND LEG, isolated, orange-paper hip cap at upper-right, long black articulated hock shape descending down-left then forward to black paw pointing right. Entire complete limb with root.
COL2: FAR HIND LEG, same but slightly narrower and receding, full root upper-right.
COL3: same HEAD/NECK RUFF as row1col2, SAME scale/outline/ears/muzzle/neck, only eyes and brows change to focused attack, narrowed small dark eyes, mouth remains tiny/closed.
ROW4:
COL1: same HEAD/NECK RUFF, only eyes/brows change to brief hurt squint, mouth tiny wince, do not move ears or reshape head.
COL2: same HEAD/NECK RUFF, only eyes/brows change to subtle happy closed arcs and tiny smile, not a giant open human mouth.
COL3: EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
Keep every silhouette complete, no cut paws/ears, no duplicate limbs, no white background or checkerboard. This is a production source sheet that will be measured and registered; no text anywhere.
